purpose: Teach: 末端/因子/ますれ/買い上げ/係数/番外/不振/とりあげ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、末端の販売員にも声をかけられた
lines.en: Father — when he was founding the company, he would greet even the junior staff by name.
lines.style: Warm, measured recollection. Gentle pride in the memory. Opens with a soft, almost wondering tone. Quiet certainty underneath. The pace of someone who has thought about this many times.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは成功因子を見極められた
lines.en: Yes. Father had a gift for recognizing potential in people.
lines.style: Affirming, steady. A son confirming his own understanding of his father's legacy. Respectful but not strained. Direct, with the weight of lived observation beneath it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員に「相談ますれば」と仰った
lines.en: Father — he would tell staff, 'If you ever need advice, come and ask me.'
lines.style: Soft voice, almost tender. The recollection catches slightly — warmth mixed with something like longing. Slow, as if he's hearing it again. Trails gently on the remembered words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは大量買い上げの契約をまとめられた
lines.en: Yes. Father was able to close that major contract because of that openness.
lines.style: Reflective nod in the voice. Not triumphant — thoughtful. Connecting cause to consequence with quiet conviction. Steady breath, grounded tempo.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、収益係数を毎期確認された
lines.en: Father — he reviewed the profit margins every single quarter without fail.
lines.style: Admiring, almost marveling. The tone of someone seeing meticulous care in retrospect. Quiet emphasis on the discipline. Slight trailing-off, as if still absorbing the lesson.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは番外の慈善活動もされた
lines.en: Yes. And he gave generously to charitable causes as well.
lines.style: Calm, comprehensive. Adding another piece to the picture. The voice of someone rounding out a portrait — not boastful, but complete. Steady, encompassing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、不振店舗の建て直しに尽力された
lines.en: Father — he put real effort into turning around the struggling stores.
lines.style: Deep appreciation in the voice. Quiet intensity around the word 'effort.' A pause before it, honoring the work. Slower pace. The tone of someone who understands what that dedication cost.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは度々経済誌にとりあげられた
lines.en: Yes. Father's work was featured in the business journals many times.
lines.style: A gentle closing statement. Pride without loudness. The voice of someone completing a remembrance. Steady, settled. A small, knowing weight — the acknowledgment of a life well-documented and well-lived.
